key_concepts: A line graph shows trends and changes over a continuous interval.
Line graph parts include title, axes, labels, line, and data points.
The x-axis is horizontal and usually represents the independent variable such as time.
The y-axis is vertical and usually represents the dependent variable such as distance.
Data points represent specific measurements at particular times.
Constructing a line graph involves labeling axes, determining variables, choosing scales,
In a distance-time graph, time is plotted on the x-axis and distance on the y-axis.
A straight upward-sloping line shows uniform or constant speed.
A flat horizontal line shows that an object is stationary.
A downward-sloping line shows that an object is going back.
A steeper line on a distance-time graph means faster speed.
The slope of a distance-time graph gives information about speed.
